pod.title: Pod
pod.alsoLikes: More than one of you also likes
pod.showMyPhoto: Show my photo to this pod
pod.showMyPhotoHint: In a pod about a private interest, photos stay hidden until each person chooses to show theirs. Yours shows once you turn this on.
pod.leaveBody: The others will only see that a member left.

next.voteBody: Say yes to every option that works for you, by {{when}}.

safety.title: Meeting safely
safety.body: Meet in a public place in daytime or early evening. Arrange your own transport and tell a friend where you're going. You can leave at any time. Never share your home address. In an emergency, call 112.

plan.title: Planner
plan.heading: Plan the meetup
plan.notPlanning: The planner opens once the pod is confirmed.
plan.lockedWon_one: Voting has closed: this time won with {{count}} yes vote.
plan.lockedWon_other: Voting has closed: this time won with {{count}} yes votes.
plan.lockedClosed: Voting has closed: this is the time that won.
plan.noOptions: No times yet. Suggest a time and a public place, and the others can vote on it.
plan.rules: The option with the most yes votes (at least 3) wins when voting closes, and your yes counts as “I'm coming”. If everyone says yes to one, it's settled right away. If nothing gets 3 yes votes, you get one extra day to add another option.
plan.timeWindow: Between 08:00 and 22:00, within the next 14 days.
plan.placeHint: Search for a café, library, park…
plan.placeHelper: Cafés, bars, libraries, parks and other public places near the pod.

errors.DATE: Pick a day and a time.
errors.WINDOW: Pick a time within 14 days, between 08:00 and 22:00.
errors.PLACE: Pick a public place from the list.

plan.extendedTitle: No time works yet — add another option
plan.extendedBody: You have one more day, until {{when}}. If no option gets 3 yes votes by then, the pod ends.
plan.placeNoResults: No public places found. Try another name.
plan.placeNotPublic: That isn't a public place. Pick a café, library, park or similar.
plan.placeFailed: Places couldn't be searched right now. Try again.
plan.reportHint: Press and hold an option to report it.

chat.title: Meetup chat
chat.privacyNote: Only your pod can read this. Messages are deleted about 3 days after the meetup. Press and hold a message to report it.
chat.membersOnly: Only current members of this pod can see its chat.
chat.empty: No messages yet. Say hi, or let the others know when you're on your way.
chat.notOpenYet: You can write here from 24 hours before the meetup until 24 hours after it.
chat.closedEnded: This chat closed 24 hours after the meetup. Messages are deleted about 3 days after it.
chat.closedOff: This chat closed because the meetup is no longer scheduled. Messages are deleted about 3 days after the original meetup time.
chat.notScheduled: The chat opens 24 hours before your meetup, once you have picked a time.
chat.contactWarningDetail: It's fine to wait until after the meetup before sharing your number or profile.

attendance.cantMakeItBody: We'll tell your pod you're not coming. Cancelling close to the meetup counts as a late cancellation.

mine.pending: You haven't said if you're coming yet.
mine.notComing: You said you can't make it.
mine.unconfirmed: You haven't confirmed. Let the others know if you're coming.
